title: The three-dimensional Wick quartic is not uniformly controlled on the fixed free-Hamiltonian form domain

declared_model.representation: K1430's symmetric Fock realization of the equal-time massive Gaussian field on normalized T^3
declared_model.interaction_vector: W_N=V_N Omega with V_N=integral :phi_N^4: dx and Omega the free vacuum
declared_model.scope: repository Gaussian/Fock control; not a released source Hamiltonian or a theorem about every renormalized representation

form_domain_obstruction.dual_norm_identity: ||(H_0+1)^(-1/2)W_N||^2=24 sum_(k1+...+k4=0) product_i q_ki /(1+sum_i omega_ki), q_k=(2 omega_k)^(-1)
form_domain_obstruction.cone_lower_bound: For 8|N and k1,k2,k3 componentwise in [N/8,N/4], k4=-(k1+k2+k3), the squared dual norm is bounded below by c_m N^4
form_domain_obstruction.necessary_form_test: A cutoff-uniform sesquilinear form bound |<psi,V_N chi>|<=C||(H_0+1)^(1/2)psi||||(H_0+1)^(1/2)chi|| would make psi -> <psi,V_N Omega> uniformly continuous on the free form domain, contradicting the divergent dual norm
form_domain_obstruction.lower_chaos_counterterms: Deterministic vacuum and quadratic counterterms occupy zeroth and second particle/chaos sectors and cannot cancel W_N's fourth-particle component
form_domain_obstruction.conclusion: Fixed nonzero coupling Wick multiplication is not uniformly KLMN-form-bounded on D((H_0+1)^(1/2)) when only deterministic mass and vacuum counterterms are added
form_domain_obstruction.operator_ceiling: This excludes the fixed-free-domain form route only; it does not exclude cutoff-dependent unitary dressing, field-strength or quartic counterterms, domain change, or a non-form strong-resolvent construction
